title: Menstrual Hygiene Awareness: Empowering Women
summary: 23 volunteers partnered with the Miaan Foundation to raise awareness about menstrual hygiene among 50 women in Noida.
description: 23 volunteers partnered with the Miaan Foundation to raise awareness about menstrual hygiene among 50 women in Noida. By addressing taboos and educating participants on hygiene practices, this initiative aimed to instill confidence, break stigma, and promote dignity in daily life.
